notes.title: Neat Corp NEW GAME REVEAL @ Creature Feature, presented by IGN
notes.notes:
The next verse in the Neat Corp poem will be unveiled May 19th in the Creature Feature, a VR only showcase organized by our friends and publishing partners Creature and presented by IGN!

The show will feature a ton of game reveals, developer highlights and more! We can’t wait to give you a first look at what we’ve been cooking in secret over some time. 🥓

All we can say now is that it’s something entirely new! Make sure to tune in at IGN next Monday! 👏

notes.title: Garden of the Sea - November Patch [v1.000047]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051942/d3d7a92af79abebc2f1807edfed4a0c5ac8f77a1.png[/img]
Happy Monday gardeners! You might have noticed a patch already having been downloaded for the game! 

It's no dramatic changes but here's what's included:[list]
[*]Added gamepad aim assist
[*]Fixed instrument playing visual effect whilst lowered
[*]Fixed SFX setting navigation
[*]Fixed missing camera sensitivity setting for Xbox and PS gamepads
[*]Fixed dual wielding through dominant hand switching in main menu
[*]Re-implemented dominant hand setting in-game
[*]Increased font sizes in menu book
[*]Fixed missing Asian language glyphs
[/list]

Happy playing! If you haven't already, we'd also love it if you left a review for the game as it helps us a ton with discoverability!  <3

notes.title: Save Directory Fix and Quality of Life Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051942/f7083a0c24991afb1908f38c615923591c9b468b.png[/img]
[h1]Good afternoon Gardeners! 
[/h1]We’re happy to share with you our first post-release patch for Garden of the Sea! Mainly this patch makes sure that VR and non-VR saves are stored and loaded separately for players who own both versions of the game but we’ve included some neat tweaks as well!
[list]
[*]Save directory fix
[*]Various gameplay improvements and fixes; including but not limited to small changes to item functionality, world collision and other quality of life tweaks
[*]UI fixes for SteamDeck
[/list]
Please let us know if there are any specific issues ailing your experience! The best way to do that is to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/neatcorp]Discord[/url] if you need help or want to talk to us! We’re (mostly😈) nice!

notes.title: Bring your garden with you on the Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051942/5665cc0cc5fc9138c7e667a12e720d7d660b429d.jpg[/img]
Whether at a friend's house, in bed, or out on the open sea, did you know that you could bring your garden with thee? That was a nice little rhyme for you to let you know that you can play Garden of the Sea.. wherever you may be? Ok, enough of that!.. 
[h3]👏 Garden of the Sea is fully playable on Steam Deck! There it is! 👏
[/h3]

Garden of the Sea is a game where taking your time, relaxation and exploration are at the core of the experience, so it felt natural for us to make sure that you can enjoy the game wherever you find yourself.
Traveling, on the go, or maybe you just need a few minutes to clear your head in a stressful situation. We want you to know that Garden of the Sea is at hand! 

We hope you will give Garden of the Sea a chance on the go! And if you do, please share it with us! 🥰

Til next time!

notes.title: 🪴 Garden of the Sea is OUT NOW! 🪴
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051942/006264d79b4fb6aff98a70c5032d56890ebd113c.png[/img]
We’re thrilled to welcome you ALL to Garden of the Sea, our sweet Farming-sim adventure, created from the core by the power of LOVE! 

Garden of the Sea (as we suspect most of you know) was originally released across various VR platforms but through our desire to bring it to even more players it brought the creation of our first ever non-VR title. 

Translating the game from VR to a more traditional format has been full of challenges and enjoyment both! We won’t go into deep detail on that today (though I’m sure we will in the future!). For now we just hope you will all enjoy the fruits of our creation in Garden of the Sea!
Check out our new trailer!
[previewyoutube=elKOXne9NF0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re all new here, you can expect to: [list]
[*]Create plant beds, fences, trellises and decor for various veggies and flowers.
[*]Nurture and care for local creatures by figuring out their favorite foods.
[*]Go fishing for new friends to hang out in your pond.
[*]Build and upgrade your house. Decorate and design it to feel like home.
[*]Cook new dishes with the veggies you have grown yourself!
[*]Stay up all night.
[*]Go exploring with your boat!
[*]Complete quests to unlock new adventures, creatures, and more!
[*]Encourage your animal friends to make babies (totally safe for work!)
[*]Find the best spot to meditate for a moment.
[*]Save your favorite moments with the in-game camera.
[/list]

notes.title: Garden of the Sea is arriving on PC and Switch October 3rd!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051942/fcbd5c7bfdd707c2dd8c6ea0ff59205666e60181.png[/img]
Hello friends! 

We're so excited to let you know Garden of the Sea is arriving on Steam and the Nintendo Switch for non-VR users on October 3rd! As the real world may be hard and cold but in this version of Garden of the Sea we hope to invite [i]more[/i] players to a soft and warm place.

In case you didn’t know, this is going to be the Steam version of our cozy first-person VR farming sim. We’ve modified it to be playable on PC and are really happy with the results, so we’re hyped to get it in your hands!

We invite you to: [list]
[*]Grow your garden
[*]Nurture and pet your local creatures
[*]Upgrade and furnish your home to your liking
[*]Adventure across the open seas and explore the lush islands of this world
[/list]
This world is your own! 

Garden of the Sea will be our first ever non-VR title and while our hearts rest firmly in VR development, we could not be more excited to bring one of our games to a new set of players! 

We hope you will be there to step onto your island with us October 3rd. Better start packing!

notes.title: We’re re-releasing Garden of the Sea in a non-VR version later this year!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!

We revealed some super duper exciting news at the Wholesome Direct this weekend: Garden of the Sea is getting a non-VR version!! 

We know some folks have been eyeing our game, which was originally released in 2019, but don’t play in VR, or have wanted to share this game with friends who don’t have VR. We also know that we’ve gotten such a lovely reception on our cozy farming sim that it felt like a waste of an opportunity to not try making it playable for way more people. So behold: later this year, we’re releasing Garden of the Sea, with all of its original features and charms, on Steam! It will have mainstream controller support, and SteamDeck compatibility, so you can just sit back and relax while fishing, watering your plants, or petting the native creatures that live on your island.

We hope you’ve enjoyed a look at our game that’s chock full of fun things to do and relaxing vibes (which we could all certainly use more of during these times)! Please feel free to wishlist it if you like what you see (it helps indies out a lot) and follow us on [url=https://x.com/NeatCorp][u]our[/u][/url] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@neatcorp][u]socials[/u][/url]! 

Talk to you soon!
